description: This file defines a PHP interface 'Generator' within the namespace 'Todaymade\Daux\Format\Base'. It declares methods for constructing a generator, generating content, and retrieving content types, intended for implementing various generator classes in the Daux documentation tool.

classes.name: Generator
classes.description: A PHP interface outlining the essential methods for generator classes used in the Daux documentation project.

methods.name: generateAll
methods.description: Generates all contents based on input and output interfaces with a specified width.

methods.name: getContentTypes
methods.description: Returns an array of content types supported by the generator.
